picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.1% in October?
picks.why: A jobless rate above 4.1% would signal a cooling labor market, shaping Federal Reserve rate decisions and recession risk assessments.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 4.5% would mark a renewed price surge, testing Federal Reserve credibility and eroding real wages for households.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries about a fifth of global oil; prolonged disruption keeps energy prices and inflation risks elevated worldwide.

picks.question: Will a Chinese company have one of the top 3 AI models by December 31?
picks.why: A Chinese top-three AI model would signal a narrowing U.S. technology lead despite export controls, with trade and security implications.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: Another AI-credited solution to a Millennium Prize problem would mark a leap in machine reasoning with broad productivity implications.

picks.question: OpenAI IPO closing market cap above $1T?
picks.why: A trillion-dollar OpenAI debut would test investor appetite for AI and could reshape public-market valuations and capital flows.
